postings.title: Contract Due Diligence Compliance Analyst
postings.description:
Your Opportunity:

Maxwell was founded in 2015 by homebuyers who were shocked by the complexity and inefficiencies of the mortgage process for borrowers and lending teams alike. We've built a platform that has not only streamlined the process and made it more efficient — closing loans 45%+ faster — but has made mortgages more accessible in the process. Our mission is clear: democratize mortgages by helping lenders work more efficiently and stay compliant while eliminating the barrier to entry and the stress for the borrower.

This is YOUR CHANCE to bring rigor and precision to a mission that's reshaping how mortgages get made. As our Contract Due Diligence Compliance Analyst, you'll dig into loan files and fees to validate regulatory compliance, working cross-functionally with our Data Capture, Credit Review, and Transaction Management teams to ensure a smooth transition from Compliance Analysis to Credit Review and beyond. This is a remote role open across the United States. If you thrive on detail, believe compliance and efficiency aren't at odds, and want to help spread financial empowerment, this is your Maxwell.

What You're Great At:

You are someone who enjoys digging in to ensure loan files and fees are accurate and compliant with regulatory standards. You understand what's needed to properly investigate and validate apparent regulatory compliance violations. Specifically, you bring:

- Strong working knowledge and experience in the LauraMac Due Diligence software system

- 3 years of experience in Quality Control/Due Diligence/Secondary Market (required), with fraud investigative review experience within banking or lending preferred

- Knowledge of the principles and compliance regulations and documentation applicable to mortgage lending

- The ability to meet production quality and service standards

- High technical aptitude, with familiarity with Slack, Zoom, GSuite, and Microsoft Office

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with analytical ability, good judgment, and a detail-oriented, organized approach

What You'll Do:

- Review loan packages, underwriting guidelines, or data files to identify the documentation necessary for the review

- Capture required information from such documentation, including bookmarking relevant pages where such information can be located, in a designated place

- Audit loans to determine salability or conduct final review of loan documentation for accuracy and completeness

- Identify and document any discrepancies during audit, tracking document issues in the process

- Enter data and fees from LEs, CDs, and COCs into the system of record and run analysis to test for issues

- Ensure any exceptions are captured and recorded for incorrect or missing documentation, data errors, and any errors on the LEs and CDs

- Research and respond to rebuttals and responses to findings

- Maintain communication with internal contacts as necessary to ensure expectations and timelines are met, escalating issues as needed

- Run system logic against information captured and handle any exceptions that may come from applying that logic against the data captured

- Apply exceptions and handle validations where necessary to ensure a complete and accurate review

- Accurately track time spent on reviews

Salary: This is a contract position and payment will be made per file, depending on the type of loan reviewed.

Why Maxwell:

We are a company focused on a supportive, diverse, and inclusive culture — lived through our values of Rigor, Ownership, Curiosity, Kindness, and "Straight Up" — to bring equality to the mortgage process and spread financial empowerment. We believe people do their best work when they're trusted, supported, and given the tools to solve real problems. Join us in helping lenders work more efficiently while making the path to homeownership less stressful for everyone involved.

postings.title: Contract Due Diligence Underwriter
postings.description:

Maxwell was founded in 2015 by homebuyers who were shocked by the complexity and inefficiencies of the mortgage process for borrowers and lending teams alike. This is YOUR CHANCE to bring rigor and precision to a mission that's reshaping how mortgages get made. As our Contract Due Diligence Underwriter, you'll dig into multi-state Non-QM, Conventional, Jumbo, Government, Correspondent, and business purpose loan packages, protecting the integrity of the loan manufacturing process for both purchases and refinances. If you thrive on detail, believe compliance and efficiency aren't at odds, and want to help spread financial empowerment, this is your Maxwell.

What You're Great At:

You are someone who enjoys digging in to ensure loan files are accurate and compliant with regulatory standards. You understand what's needed to properly investigate inconsistencies in loan files to protect against fraud, negligence, errors, and omissions. Specifically, you bring:

- Strong working knowledge and experience in the LauraMac Due Diligence software system

- 5+ years of current experience in underwriting, preferably with prior experience in Quality Control

- Minimum 1-year Due Diligence experience at a mortgage lending institution

- Familiarity with best practices for post-close quality control on newly and seasoned originated mortgages

- Strong knowledge of Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac guidelines, QM/ATR

- Proficiency in Non-QM loan processes and requirements

- A deep understanding of DSCR/business purpose loans

- The ability to work with multiple investor guidelines and overlays

- Strong ability to properly calculate income across a variety of earning types, from wage earners to business/self-employed income

- Strong appraisal review skills

- Excellent analytical and communication skills

- Proficiency in pipeline management with the ability to multitask in a high-volume environment

- The ability to work independently as well as contribute in a team environment

What You'll Do:

- Review mortgage loan files to ensure the accuracy of the information and verify the presence of all required documents

- Perform due diligence review of the residential mortgage loan application and documentation as submitted to ensure loans meet specific investor/product guidelines and AUS requirements as applicable

- Analyze borrower's credit profile, collateral, and capacity to repay the proposed mortgage obligation, including accurately calculating income and ensuring the borrower's ability to repay

- Properly calculate and analyze loan-to-value ratios and debt carried

- Analyze purchase contracts, title commitments, and other loan-pertinent documentation

- Enter review results into the company's proprietary software

- Execute risk analysis and make decisions regarding deficiencies identified during the review process, recommending resolution

- Stay current on all agency, state, and multiple investor guidelines

- Participate in ongoing training as the industry evolves

- Manage time efficiently and prioritize workloads to meet minimum daily production goals

- Clear QA feedback and perform within department audit standards

- Adhere to the company's Core Values

- Other duties as assigned by manager

Salary: This is a contract position and payment will be made per file, depending on the type of loan reviewed.

postings.title: Sales Account Executive (Mortgage Tech, SaaS)
postings.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is to build enterprise software and products that empower people to make mortgage lending simpler and more accessible.

Maxwell was founded in 2015 by homebuyers who were shocked by the complexity of the mortgage process for borrowers and lending teams alike. Somehow, in the mix of paperwork, points, and process, the humanity and emotion of the largest financing decision of a person's life had been lost. After spending a year with over 1,000 mortgage professionals, the founding team realized we needed to focus on making the people who make a difference shine. Now, we employ a world-class team of software experts and mortgage professionals who pull up our socks every morning to do just that. We're privileged that our company has been recognized by HousingWire, Deloitte, the Mortgage Bankers Association, and others as a leading innovator in our industry. We are a committed team doing honest work that matters in the real world — one lender, one borrower, one homeowner at a time. And it works.

Today our digital mortgage platform powers hundreds of mortgage lending institutions nationwide, from independent mortgage banks and credit unions to brokers and community banks. We work to make them, and their employees, the real heroes who enable homeowners to achieve the American Dream. 

WHO YOU ARE

You are a high-performing, quota-carrying Account Executive who thrives in complex, consultative sales environments. You know how to navigate sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and nuanced customer needs. You bring structure, urgency, and creativity to every deal. You combine a strong hunter mentality with the ability to build trust quickly, positioning yourself as a true partner to your prospects. You’re equally comfortable generating pipeline as you are closing it, and you take pride in owning your number end-to-end. Most importantly, you’re motivated by solving real problems for customers and can clearly articulate how technology drives meaningful business outcomes.

- Sales Strategy: Develop and execute thoughtful, account-based sales strategies tailored to the needs and challenges of mortgage lenders, consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets.

- Pipeline Ownership: Build, manage, and convert a healthy pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting, inbound follow-up, and partner collaboration.

- Client Acquisition: Identify and engage prospective customers, run effective discovery and product demonstrations, and close new business with confidence.

- Consultative Selling: Lead with curiosity, deeply understand customer workflows, pain points, and goals, and map our solutions to measurable business value.

- Account Management Mindset: Establish strong foundations with new customers that drive long-term success, expansion, and retention.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with marketing, product, and customer success to deliver a seamless and compelling customer experience.

- Data-Driven Execution: Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and performance tracking using tools like Salesforce and other modern sales technologies.

- Market Awareness: Stay informed on industry trends, competitive dynamics, and regulatory changes within the mortgage and fintech landscape to identify new opportunities.

IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE

- Drive Revenue Growth: Own a core revenue segment of the business by consistently closing high-quality, high-value deals with mortgage lenders.

- Expand Market Presence: Help establish Maxwell as the go-to platform for modern mortgage operations by winning key logos and expanding into new segments.

- Shape Our Sales Motion: Provide frontline insights that influence pricing, packaging, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

- Elevate the Customer Experience: Act as the bridge between prospect and product, ensuring customers clearly understand the value we deliver and why it matters.

- Build Durable Relationships: Create long-term partnerships with lenders that lead to expansion, retention, and advocacy.

- Raise the Bar: Bring a high-performance mindset that pushes the team forward and contributes to a culture of accountability and excellence.

IDEALLY YOU'LL HAVE

- 5-7+ years of closing experience in mortgage-related SaaS, with meaningful exposure to the mortgage industry and lending workflows

- Proven ability to close complex, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful ACV

- Strong discovery and consultative selling skills: you ask better questions than your competitors

- Comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment

- Familiarity with modern sales tools (Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc.) and disciplined pipeline management

- Willingness to travel (~20-30%) to meet prospects and customers, attend industry events, and build meaningful relationships in-market

- A bias toward action, curiosity, and continuous improvement

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

- You’re Selling Real Impact, Not Shelfware. Our platform directly impacts how lenders operate and how borrowers experience one of the most important financial moments of their lives.

- A Category Still Being Defined. Mortgage tech is undergoing massive transformation. This is an opportunity to help shape how modern lending gets done, not just sell into an established category.

- High Visibility, High Ownership. You won’t be one of many AEs in a rigid system, you’ll have real influence on how we sell, who we target, and how we win.

- Access to Leadership & Fast Feedback Loops. Work closely with leadership, product, and marketing in a tight, collaborative environment where your insights actually drive decisions.

- Not Just a Desk Sale. This role blends modern SaaS selling with real-world relationship building—you’ll be in-market with customers, at industry events, and face-to-face when it matters most.

- Meaningful Deals, Not Volume for Volume’s Sake. This is a strategic, consultative sale with fewer, bigger, more impactful deals with real business outcomes.

- Mission That Actually Matters. You’re helping make homeownership more accessible and improving a process that affects millions of people, not just hitting quota.

Compensation: $80,000–$110,000 base salary, with On-Target Earnings (OTE) typically ranging from 1.5x to 2x the base salary.

postings.title: Strategic Account Executive, Mortgage Technology & Services
postings.description:
WHO WE ARE

Maxwell is on a mission to make mortgage lending simpler, more accessible, and more efficient for lenders, borrowers, and the teams who support them.

Founded in 2015, Maxwell has built a modern mortgage technology platform used by hundreds of lenders nationwide, including independent mortgage banks, banks, credit unions and brokers. Our software helps lenders create better borrower experiences, streamline origination workflows, and operate more efficiently in a complex and highly regulated industry.

Today, Maxwell’s business spans both technology and services: our point-of-sale and automation products, our fulfillment services and our mortgage diligence solutions. This gives us a unique ability to meet lenders where they are, whether they need modern software, operational leverage or a strategic partner to help them navigate a changing mortgage market.

WHO YOU ARE

You are a senior, consultative seller who understands that enterprise mortgage sales are won through trust, insight, persistence, and business value, not generic demos or transactional pitches. You know how to navigate complex enterprise-scale lender organizations, build champions, multi-thread across stakeholders and develop opportunities over months or years. You are energized by strategic selling, but you also have the discipline and grit to build pipeline yourself.

You are equally comfortable talking with a CEO about growth strategy, an operations leader about workflow efficiency, a technology leader about implementation risk, and a revenue leader about borrower conversion. You know how to listen deeply, diagnose a customer’s business problem and connect the right mix of technology and services to a compelling outcome.

- Strategic Enterprise Selling: Own complex sales cycles with independent mortgage banks, banks, credit unions, and other mortgage lending organizations, typically involving multiple executive and operational stakeholders.

- Pipeline Creation: Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted outbound, relationship development, events, referrals, and account-based prospecting.

- Consultative Discovery: Understand each lender’s origination model, operational workflows, technology stack, pain points, and business priorities before positioning a solution.

- Solution Selling: Sell across Maxwell’s technology and services portfolio, including SaaS, automation, fulfillment, and related mortgage solutions.

- Executive Engagement: Build credibility with senior leaders and translate Maxwell’s value into business outcomes around efficiency, conversion, cost, scalability, and customer experience.

- Product Storytelling: Partner with Sales Engineering and Product, while owning the customer narrative and ensuring demos are tailored to the prospect’s actual workflows and priorities.

- Account Strategy: Build and manage a focused target account list, identify whitespace, develop champions, and nurture long-cycle opportunities with discipline.

- Market Presence: Represent Maxwell at industry events, conferences, and in-market meetings with prospects and customers.

IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE

- Help Maxwell expand its presence with upper mid-market and enterprise mortgage lenders.

- Drive new revenue across both software and fulfillment / services opportunities.

- Shape how Maxwell positions its broader platform in the market.

- Build strategic relationships with lenders that can grow into long-term partnerships.

- Bring market feedback to Product, Customer Success, Operations, and leadership.

- Help raise the bar for consultative, relationship-driven selling across the GTM team.

IDEALLY YOU’LL HAVE

- 10+ years of B2B sales experience, including meaningful experience selling into mortgage lenders.

- Deep familiarity with mortgage origination, lender workflows and the mortgage technology ecosystem.

- Proven success selling SaaS, technology-enabled services, outsourcing, fulfillment or complex operational solutions.

- Experience managing upper mid-market or enterprise opportunities with ACVs in the six-figure and seven-figure ranges.

- Ability to self-source a meaningful portion of your pipeline.

- Strong executive presence and comfort selling to C-level, operations, technology, sales and compliance stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to run consultative discovery, build business cases and connect solutions to measurable customer outcomes.

- Experience partnering with Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations to win and implement complex deals.

- Comfort with travel for customer meetings, onsite visits and industry events.

- Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and similar sales technologies.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

- You’re Selling More Than Software: Maxwell is not just another point solution. You’ll have the ability to sell across software, automation, fulfillment, and services — giving you a broader and more strategic value proposition.

- A Market That Needs New Models: Mortgage lenders are under pressure to reduce cost, improve efficiency, modernize borrower experience, and do more with less. Maxwell is positioned to help them rethink both their technology and operating model.

- Strategic, Relationship-Driven Sales: This is not a high-volume transactional sales role. The right candidate will build trust over time, develop executive relationships, and create opportunities through insight and persistence.

- High Visibility and Real Influence: You’ll work closely with Maxwell leadership and cross-functional teams. Your market feedback, account strategy, and customer insights will influence how we package, position, and sell our solutions.

COMPENSATION

The base salary range for this role is expected to be $130,000 to $150,000, with estimated on-target earnings of approximately $225,000 to $250,000 through base salary and commission. Actual compensation will depend on experience, skills, and alignment with the role. For exceptional candidates, Maxwell may consider thoughtful ramp support or other transition-related structures as part of the overall offer package.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

An opportunity to be a key part of an agile team of thinkers and doers working to improve a multi-trillion-dollar industry. We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, top-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance, flexible time off, and a culture that values ownership, humility, and impact. Benefits include:

- Competitive pay and meaningful equity in a well-funded, late-stage growth company

- Full medical, dental and vision insurance with HSA options

- 401(k) matching 

- Flexible paid time off and major holidays

- Ability to participate in employee stock purchase programs

- A team that cares deeply about doing honest work that matters

OUR APPLICATION PROCESS

At Maxwell, we value our differences and encourage all qualified candidates to apply. Maxwell is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you require accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to peopleops@maxwell.com. All employment decisions at Maxwell are based on merit, business needs, and role requirements.

We are not accepting opportunities from contingency staffing agencies at this time.
